notes.title: Update Complete!
notes.content:
Game Updated. 


- New Mini map & World map.

- New Ai and Re Balancing.

- Now Starting New Game with some Recipes.

- You can Throw Dodonpa/Corori for killing enemies silently.

- Abandoned Jissou/Family Jissou Spawn Everyday. You can see their location in Wold map.

- Pregnant Counter added. Now you can see How many babies in your stomach.

- Now You Can Make Slave by Throwing poo to enemies Thumby. 

- Now some peoples are kicking you or ignoring you.

- Now some people gives you Candies!

- Now Babies are increasing your Hunger Reduction. Slaves are doesn't increasing Hunger reduction but they never grown up. Slaves are Working harder than babies.

- And....Many Bugs are Fixed. 

Well... Understand?

uh.....Thankyou!

notes.title: Update Released!
notes.content:
Park Life ~Circuit of Happiness ~ Ver. Uzicha Unchi Daisuki Refu Released!

*My English is so bad. if you Find typo or some Errors, Just Lol!

* Now You Can Play In The New Park.(Smallpark * 4 Size.)

* Main Actor Animation Changed for using Weapons and gestures.

* 67 Items and 24 Recipe Added. Goodbye! 4 Elements! They will never come back but... always with us. 

*Now you can see Tutorials in ESC Menu. Yes! Now that ESC Menu Never kick you out!  And... This 'Tutorials' menu will be change to Option menu. Maybe someday. whatever.

* Save and Load Make some stopping but it's not bug. Giving little time to them. then Save or Load will go on.  I....will make Loading screen..ASAP...

*If you Dead, You can press 'Load' button on gameover screen now.

* 7 shops added. they refresh their stuff everyday. 

* Now maternity Completely Changed.  You must find toilet before, bur Now! You can Use Flower in every where!! 1 flower can make 4 to 12 babies, and if you use more, You can Make  max 20 babies in Once.
in your maternity, Toilet or water will help you.

*And Many of things are changed! Hope you enjoy. Park Life will be better on every update. I promise.  


*Ah,  Humans & Enemies are More stronger than before but they still foolish. Wait for the Next update Plz... Welcome to the Fool World!
